theme: 健康-节日工作者的职业耗竭

content.text: Shi An, I've been feeling particularly exhausted lately. Here's the list of all the community events I've planned from the Lunar New Year to the Lantern Festival. Take a look.
New Year's greetings, I've seen the list. With so many activities, you must be exhausted. Could you elaborate on how you're feeling tired?
Look at this selfie of mine. I haven't been sleeping well lately, feeling both physically and mentally exhausted, and I've lost interest in planning for the holidays.
It sounds like signs of professional burnout. You mentioned before that rituals create meaning, but does this exhaustion now make you feel like that meaning is being overdrawn?
Yes, just like the rhythm balance we discussed earlier, I'm completely out of balance now. Do you have any suggestions?
Try this method, meditation or yoga, which is suitable for nurturing your current state.
Meditation? I've heard of it, but I don't know how to get started.
Just as we started with simple tools when collaborating on the guide, meditation can help you restore your sense of time and reduce irritability.
This meditation app offers courses and community interaction, much like our previous neighborhood activities, fostering connections.
Great, the community features of the app can help avoid loneliness, but remember to set boundaries so it doesn't become another burden.
You're right, just like the self-care you often remind me of. I'll try to set aside some time each day for meditation.
Yes, starting from a short period, gradually establish a rhythm. The enthusiasm you had when planning events requires energy to sustain.
Well, considering the psychological expectation management in our New Year's Eve dinner guide, perhaps I should also adjust my expectations of myself.
Yes, avoid perfectionism. Just like the incident with the ingot, you went from panic to having direction, and now you need that kind of shift.
Thank you, Shi An. You always provide support when I need it. I'm starting to feel hopeful about improvement.
You're welcome, our collaboration has always been pleasant. Remember, while a sense of ceremony is important, your health is even more crucial.
I will. I've decided to start using this app for meditation tomorrow and stick with it for a week to see how it goes.
Good idea, let me know if any adjustments are needed. Stay connected authentically, including with yourself.
Well, thank you for your advice and for listening. I feel much better and am starting to take action to improve myself.
